WATCH │Thousands of climate advocates, members of the religious sector, and civil society groups march through E. Rodriguez Sr. Avenue in Quezon City on November 15, 2025, to protest and decry the domination of a rotten system that forces people to suffer the harshest impacts of the climate crisis. The action, dubbed the “Global Day of Action for Climate Justice,” takes place alongside the Conference of the Parties (COP) of the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC). 

🎥: Manny Palmero

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Shear Line
Issued at: 2:00 PM, 15 November 2025(Saturday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Nueva Ecija(Bongabon, Gabaldon, Laur, Pantabangan, Rizal, General Mamerto Natividad, Palayan, Llanera, San Jose, Talavera, Munoz, Cabanatuan, Santa Rosa, General Tinio, Penaranda, Santo Domingo, Gapan, San Leonardo, Jaen, Aliaga, Quezon), Bulacan(Dona Remedios Trinidad, San Miguel) and Quezon(General Nakar).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Pampanga, Tarlac, Bataan, Zambales, Nueva Ecija(Carranglan, Lupao, Talugtug, Cuyapo, Guimba, Nampicuan, Licab, Zaragoza, San Antonio, Cabiao, San Isidro), Bulacan(San Ildefonso, San Rafael, Angat, Norzagaray, Baliuag, Bustos, Santa Maria, Pandi, Pulilan, Plaridel, Calumpit, Hagonoy, Paombong, Malolos, Bulakan, Guiguinto, Bocaue, Balagtas, San Jose del Monte, Meycauayan, Marilao, Obando), Quezon(Panukulan, Burdeos, Polillo, Patnanungan, Jomalig), Metro Manila(Caloocan, Valenzuela, Navotas, Malabon) and Rizal(Rodriguez) within the next 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 PM today.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
